items.title: Walter Booker and Jimmy Cobb interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Once I was working with Betty Carter... [INTERVIEWEE] ...I had worked with her before... But we were playing... she came and look at me... 'do something.'

ctx.x: Betty Carter was going around trying to promote the brothers to play. Because they was into rock ‘n roll. You know they got into rock ‘n roll because I guess that’s what was happening where they were. So she went around wherever she worked and tried to promote the young brothers getting back into the jazz thing. So then it came back around again, with Marsalis. And Marsalis and them are throwing a whole lot of young guys in there. You know Louisiana is throwing a whole pile of people in there. So that started…

Because it is accessibility and exposure that creates the flow of it happening. In other words, the more it’s exposed, the more people will like it, the more people will want to play it, you know what I mean, it’s a cycle, you know the cycle —
